name: Squirrel Girl: Nuts About Squirrels
notes: Squirrel Girl makes a Squirrel every time she enters or attacks, and her activated ability makes as many Squirrels as you already control. The deck ramps, doubles the Squirrel pile two or three times, then swarms.
Turns 1–3: Undercover Skrull or Guy in the Chair, then a land drop. Restorative Technique and Spider-Man, Brooklyn Visionary fetch more lands.

Turns 4–6: Cast Squirrel Girl, attack for a Squirrel, then activate {1}{G}{G}{G} to double the pile. Spider-Ham gives every Squirrel +1/+1, Tippy-Toe adds a Food to every token batch, and Peter Parker's Camera copies the doubling. Supportive Parents and Dependable Quinjet turn spare Squirrels into mana.
Closing: Swing with the army. Rhino and Training Regimen hand out counters and trample, World War Hulk doubles a threat, and Lucky and Heroic Feast turn all that Food into more counters.

Bracket 2: Built from what you own, including Jumpstart cards (tagged MSC). Radioactive Spider can fetch Spider-Ham; that's the only tutor. No combos or extra turns. Web of Life and Destiny and Earth's Mightiest Heroes are maybes: swap them in for S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier and H.E.R.B.I.E. if you find them.

Set tags: MSH = Marvel Super Heroes, SPM = Marvel's Spider-Man, MSC = Marvel Super Heroes Commander and Jumpstart cards. Every card listed is one you own. Hot Dog Cart and Dependable Quinjet are in all five Marvel B2 decks; some other commons and uncommons are shared too.
